title: Roster dispatch return (bounded manifest)
description: The bounded return every dispatched agent's run is held to, canonical here for any roster brief's output_schema reference to resolve against. The wire enforcement is boundary.Manifest's own decode (DisallowUnknownFields plus a per-class byte ceiling), not this document compiled as a validator, so this file and that struct must agree on shape. A control-plane verdict (a review's pass/fix) is one of these manifests too — the verdict rides in status, never a separate field.

status.description: The run's own pass/fail, or, for a control-plane verdict, the verdict token itself from the harness policy's declared vocabulary.

artifact_paths.description: Where the deliverable actually lives. The only route back to deliverable bytes this manifest carries; nothing that reads this manifest opens these paths on the manifest's behalf.

facts.description: A FEW key facts about the run, never a restatement of the deliverable itself.

next_action.description: What happens next, as this run's own stated claim.
